Every gathering, in bloom.

Zahana is a family-run bar and beverage styling company, built around one idea: a drink station should feel like part of the décor, not an afterthought. Every stall is designed to match the mood of the event — soft, botanical, a little lavish.

We run four bars — mocktail, coffee, cocktail and boba — and build each menu around the occasion, whether that's an intimate garden celebration or a full corporate activation.

For Every Occasion

Private & corporate events

Every stall is custom-built and styled to the room — nothing off the shelf.

Private

Weddings & Celebrations

Weddings, engagements, birthdays and intimate gatherings — a bar stall designed around your palette and theme.

  • Custom drink menu & naming to match your event
  • Lavish stall styling — florals, drapery, signage
  • Mocktail, coffee, cocktail or boba, individually or combined
  • On-site bartenders and baristas
Corporate

Corporate Activations

Product launches, offsites, conferences and brand activations — beverage service that fits the brand.

  • Branded cups, napkins & stall signage
  • High-volume service for large headcounts
  • Flexible packages by the hour or by the guest
  • Dedicated event coordinator
